method.claude_cache: 5-minute TTL; reads at cache_control breakpoints with 20-block lookback; no breakpoints = no caching
method.gpt_cache: automatic prefix cache >=1024 tokens in 128-token steps; render order instructions->tools->input (tools-first also reported)
